Bestände, Beschaffung, Materialflüsse und Projektzuordnung sollen künftig KI-gestützt und weitgehend automatisch laufen statt manuell gepflegt zu werden. Kurz gesagt: Du behandelst nicht nur die einzelnen Projekte – du behandelst die Warenwirtschaft selbst als Projekt . jobs.description: Transforming factory scans into digital reality At RIIICO, we're reimagining how factories adapt to change. Our AI-powered software makes complex production environments editable, interactive, and collaborative, turning manufacturing planning into something anyone can engage with, not just the experts. We’re looking for a 3D Data Operator to help power the foundation of our digital factory experiences. No point cloud experience needed, just an eye for detail and curiosity about 3D. Configure and verify model outputs to ensure quality, consistency, and usability for downstream applications (e.g., Nvidia Omniverse, Siemens Plant Simulation and others). Collaborate with AI-assisted tools to validate and correct automated results. Flag and troubleshoot anomalies or edge cases in raw or processed data, and document issues clearly (e.g., as Git issues). Track and report your weekly processing output. Continuously improve workflows and documentation based on team feedback and real-world challenges. What we are looking for Strong attention to detail and ability to reliably handle repetitive tasks with care. Self-motivated and dependable: you take responsibility and get things done. jobs.title: Senior C++ Performance Engineer (all genders)
jobs.description: About the role At Agile Robots, we build powerful software frameworks to orchestrate complex robotic systems and solve challenging tasks. The solutions are sold to various international customers to enable them to control their robotic work cells. Smooth integration and scalable deployment are key goals.  AgileCore is meant to be a scalable platform that supports multiple projects in parallel. That only works if the platform underneath scales with it - if it stays fast, thread-safe, and diagnosable as projects, devices, and operating conditions multiply. We are looking for a Senior C++ Performance Engineer to join our AgileCore Runtime core team. This is a T-shaped role in a small senior team: you are a full member of the core team first - contributing to the Runtime, reviewing contributions from the teams that build on our platform, and sharing our support and release duties - and within the team, you own the performance and stability practice as your specialization. On the specialization side, you will drive the performance of the Runtime core - the Blackboard, the Behavior Engine and the execution paths beneath them - make the system provably thread-safe under load, and make failures in the field fast to diagnose. You own the practice: the methodology, the tooling, the benchmarks, the audits and the education. You work hand in hand with the platform architect, who owns the performance budgets and hot-path interface contracts at the architecture level - you turn those budgets into measured, enforced reality and shape them with your findings. You set the standard for performance, concurrency and troubleshooting, and raise the team s ability to meet it without slowing feature development down. This is a shipping role, not a research role: success is measured in merged improvements, closed field escalations and green regression gates - not in microbenchmark leaderboards. We optimize to the budget the product needs, not to zero. Why this role Greenfield

As our Technical Business Development Intern for Emerging Verticals in the Data Science & Machine Learning team in Pre-Development, you help us find out where. Working directly with our project lead for Emerging Verticals, who mentors you, you explore new application fields for widefield magnetic imaging. You dig into the science and the markets behind them, talk to potential customers and users, and help turn promising ideas into first feasibility studies with our magnetic field imaging system. You see how a deep tech company decides where its technology goes next, and help shape that decision. This is a full-time internship for 6 months, starting as soon as possible. Who we are Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing. Why join Quantum Diamonds? Picture this: Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide. Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday. Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on. jobs.description: Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world s most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World s Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states. As part of Waymo s Legal team, you will work on the exciting legal issues surrounding our transformational autonomous driving technology and help drive our business lines forward from technology ideation through scaled commercial deployment. We partner with our public policy, safety, security and privacy experts to define transportation policy for the autonomous driving world to come, advising on regulatory changes that support and protect our users around the world. We collaborate with our engineering, product, strategy and operations teams to develop and protect our intellectual property portfolio and drive our corporate and commercial transactions. We ensure compliance with an increasingly complex and dynamic range of global regulations. And we anticipate, mitigate, and litigate high-profile and precedent-setting legal matters. In this hybrid role, you will report into our Managing Counsel.  You will: Serve as the primary, on-the-ground Privacy Counsel for Waymo s operations, product launches, and engineering initiatives across Germany and the broader EU, acting as a trusted advisor to ensure compliance with GDPR, ePrivacy, and local laws like the BDSG. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $200M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide. Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. You're the partner who keeps the work pointed at the highest-impact outcomes, ready to pick up the keyboard alongside the FDE when the moment calls for it. We're looking for engineers with strategic instincts: people who can write code, but whose deepest strength is the strategic, opinionated lens they bring across every phase of a deployment - spotting where value lives, scoping it realistically, and partnering with engineers to capture it from prototype to production. jobs.title: Supply Chain Manager
jobs.description: About pplwise pplwise is a recruiting consultancy for fast-growing technology companies across Europe. Through Recruiting as a Service and Executive Search, we fill key roles for our clients, from start-ups to publicly listed companies. We are filling this position for our client Filics. About our client: Filics Filics is reinventing intralogistics with autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) that change how material moves. Its double-runner system makes Filics the first and only AMR that can drive through load carriers such as Euro pallets. This breaks with forklift logic and sets a new standard for efficiency. Filics is a small, hands-on team that solves hard problems with engineering excellence. Leadership goes to those who take initiative and consistently deliver. As Supply Chain Manager (m/f/d) at Filics, you will build the supply chain that takes the robots into series production. About the role This is an on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to engineering and assembly. Filics robots are built from hundreds of components. Many come from a single source, and most aren’t under contract yet. Moving from prototypes to series production, one missing part can stop the whole line. Your job is to build a robust supply chain from scratch. It needs to know exactly what Filics depends on, secure those parts before they become a risk, and hold up as volumes grow, all while production is already running. You take full ownership of how every component is sourced, secured and managed. You’ll work closely with Engineering, which owns the technical specs and qualifies suppliers and alternative components. Assembly depends on reliable supply to plan builds. Leadership sets volume commitments based on your analysis. What you’ll do Identify critical dependencies, lock in availability through supplier contracts, and qualify alternatives so no single source can stop production Set up the ERP and the systems the supply chain runs on, including supplier quality tracking Define clear quality

Both integrate with the client's identity, security, delivery and audit services, and both need owners, approval routes and support arrangements on the client side. You will own delivery outcomes from mobilisation through production release and operating handover, acting as the client sponsor's day-to-day counterpart. The role reaches across engineering, business leadership, security, risk, compliance and operations. You will bring these groups together to agree how the platform is governed and supported, and what evidence they need for assurance in a regulated environment. You will lead an EggAI delivery team with a mix of Platform Engineering roles and skills. Client application teams develop the business use cases; you lead AI platform delivery and the changes needed for teams to adopt and operate it. Why this role Most organisations are still working out how to let AI agents act safely in production: who approves what an agent may do, how its actions are evidenced, and who answers when something goes wrong. The operating models, approval routes and assurance practices you design with our clients will shape how they run agentic AI for years, and they will become the basis of how EggAI delivers across Europe. jobs.title: Business Development Representative (BDR)
jobs.description: Let’s fix hospitality, for good. Hospitality is tough – margins are thin, waste is high, and teams are stretched. But it doesn’t have to be this hard. That’s why we built Nory . Our CEO, Conor, knows the pain first-hand. After founding and scaling Mad Egg in Ireland, he got fed up with juggling “market-leading” systems, clunky spreadsheets, and endless printouts. So he set out to build the tool he wished he’d had from day one. Nory is an all-knowing restaurant management system. It blends real-time data with AI predictive analytics, giving operators control of their margins. From food prep to forecasting, it’s operational intelligence that helps restaurants run with consistency, certainty, and profit. The result? Thriving restaurants, better jobs, less waste, healthier margins. And we’re just getting started. Fresh off a Series B led by Kinnevik , we’ve grown to 100+ people across Ireland, the UK, and Spain – and demand is scaling faster than we ever imagined. We’re looking for a Business Development Representative (BDR) to join our London team and help power our outbound engine. This is an early-career role for someone hungry to learn sales from the ground up, with real ownership of the first conversations we have with restaurant operators. This role is based in our London office , with at least 3 days a week in the office. What you’ll be doing: Own outbound – Start conversations with restaurant and hospitality operators through cold calls, emails and LinkedIn. Learn fast – Work closely with AEs, Marketing and the wider BDR team, and act on feedback to sharpen your craft every week. Pipeline management – Build and maintain a healthy pipeline to support our Account Executives in consistently smashing monthly revenue targets. Account research – Find the right decision-makers and learn what matters to their business, using sales tools and online research. Messaging & campaign execution – Craft and deliver personalised, value-led messaging that speaks to our prospects.

jobs.description: Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry. Its offerings include very energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers. Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges. Learn more at: Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions Description of the Project As a Quantum Applications Engineer , you will work at the intersection of quantum algorithms, real-world applications and customer projects . Your mission will be to identify relevant problems that can be addressed using Quandela's quantum computing technology, assess their feasibility and define how meaningful performance should be measured. Working directly with industrial and academic partners, you will translate real-world challenges into quantum computing problems, evaluate potential approaches and establish the appropriate benchmarks against classical methods. This is a highly technical role with strong exposure to customers and partners. It is particularly suited to someone with a background in quantum algorithms who wants to apply that expertise to practical use cases rather than focus exclusively on theoretical research. jobs.description: About us EggAI is a fast-growing AI consulting and development startup. We build agentic AI solutions for enterprise clients. We are growing in several European markets. The role You will own the design of a shared AI platform for our clients. The platform has two parts. An AI Control Plane governs what agents may do, through identity and delegated permissions, policy enforcement, approvals, budgets and durable audit records. A managed AI Runtime is where the agents run. Both integrate with the client's identity, security, delivery and audit services. You will set the architecture, define how services and controls fit together, and make sure what the team builds is sound, assured and ready for production. The role reaches across engineering, security, audit, risk and the client's architecture function. You will take designs through their governance, record the decisions, and give the engineers a design they can build and the client a design they can approve. You will be EggAI's accountable architecture lead on the engagement, leading design for a delivery team of platform engineers. You make the technical decisions within the team's remit, recommend on the rest, and secure the client's approval where their architecture or risk governance requires it. Unser Haus bietet 92 Zimmer, rund 810 m² Tagungsfläche in sieben Räumen (bis 410 m² am Stück), Restaurant & Bar in Planung, Gym, Sauna und kostenfreie Parkplätze. Für unser Firmenkunden- und Tagungsgeschäft suchen wir eine Vertriebsleitung, die es mit uns aufbaut. Ihre Aufgaben Sie bauen unseren Vertrieb auf – mit direkter Berichtslinie an die Hotelleitung. Sie gewinnen Firmenkunden, Verbände und Agenturen für Tagungen und Übernachtungen. Sie verhandeln Firmenraten, Kontingente und Rahmenverträge. Sie entwickeln mit unserem Eventmanagement Tagungspauschalen und Pakete. Sie vertreten das Haus auf Messen, in Netzwerken und bei Site-Inspections. Zu einem späteren Zeitpunkt übernehmen Sie die Zusammenarbeit mit unserer Leisure Sales Agentur Ihr Profil Sie haben mindestens fünf Jahre B2B-Vertrieb hinter sich – in der Hotellerie, bei einem Kongresszentrum oder einer Eventagentur. Sie kennen Entscheider in Rhein-Main oder wissen genau, wie Sie dieses Netzwerk aufbauen. Sie sind Jäger, nicht Verwalter: Akquise und Abschlüsse sind Ihr Alltag. Sie sprechen verhandlungssicher Deutsch und Englisch. Das erwartet Sie bei uns Unbefristete Festanstellung in Vollzeit mit 30 Urlaubstagen Festgehalt plus ungedeckelte Provision auf Neukundenumsatz Direkte Berichtslinie an die Hotelleitung und kurze Entscheidungswege in einem inhabergeführten Haus Firmenwagen, auch zur privaten Nutzung Firmenlaptop und Firmenhandy Kostenloses Parken direkt am Hotel Rabatte bei vielen Firmen über Mitarbeiterangebote Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Business Development Representative (m/w/d) - AI Agent Platform
jobs.description: Ninox ist eine Berliner Low-Code-Plattform, mit der Teams genau die Geschäftsanwendungen bauen, die sie brauchen. Rund 80 Mitarbeitende, tausende Kundinnen und Kunden in ganz Europa, vom kleinen Team bis zum Großunternehmen. Ein Produkt, an dem Menschen wirklich hängen. Wir sind seit 12 Jahren am Markt, etabliert, wachsen und sind solide mit Wagniskapital finanziert. Worum es geht Du machst Outbound. Zu 100 %, und vor allem am Telefon. Du bekommst Zielaccounts aus Branchen, die wir vorab festlegen, findest dort die Menschen, die das Problem tatsächlich haben, rufst sie an — und buchst qualifizierte Erstgespräche für unsere Account Executives. Nach dem Handover übernimmt der AE. Dein Ergebnis ist das stattgefundene, qualifizierte Gespräch, nicht der Abschluss und nicht der Kalendereintrag. Der größte Teil unseres Geschäfts sind kleine und mittlere Unternehmen, dazu kommt ein solider Anteil Mid-Market. Innerhalb der Verticals, die für uns nachweislich funktionieren, gehen wir gelegentlich auch in größere Organisationen. Damit es keine Missverständnisse gibt: „Enterprise" heißt bei uns Unternehmen mit einigen hundert bis wenigen tausend Mitarbeitenden — nicht DAX-Konzern mit zweijährigem Beschaffungsprozess und Rahmenvertragsverhandlung. Du arbeitest auf Deutsch und auf Englisch, jeden Tag. Deutschland und Großbritannien sind unsere Kernmärkte, weitere europäische Länder kommen situativ dazu. Dein Umfeld, ehrlich beschrieben: Unser Vertrieb arbeitet heute Full-Funnel. Die Account Executives machen neben allem anderen rund eine Stunde Outbound pro Tag. Dazu kommt eine Kollegin bzw. ein Kollege mit ebenfalls reinem Outbound-Fokus, allerdings auf Kooperationen, Webinare und Partner. Du bist damit die erste Person bei uns, die ausschließlich und direkt auf Neukunden-Erstgespräche geht. Das heißt: Es gibt Erfahrung im Haus, an die du andocken kannst, und ein Playbook, das gerade entsteht. Welche Branchen wir angehen und mit welchen Kampagnen, verantworten unser Head of Sale

Über eine halbe Million Menschen folgen ihm: über 250.000 auf TikTok, rund 200.000 auf Instagram und über 130.000 auf YouTube, dazu kommt ein Newsletter mit 15.000 Leser:innen. Seine Videos erreichen jeden Monat Millionen von Menschen. Henry ist SPIEGEL-Bestsellerautor und TEDx-Speaker. Er erklärt, wie unser Gehirn lernt, sich konzentriert und motiviert bleibt, und zwar so, dass es jeder versteht und direkt im Alltag anwenden kann. Aus dieser Marke sind bereits zwei Unternehmen entstanden: StudyAcademy, wo wir Studierenden mit neurowissenschaftlichen Lernmethoden helfen, und Neurobites, unser funktionelles Kaugummi für Fokus und Energie. Und wir stehen erst am Anfang. Unser Ziel ist es, die größte Neurowissenschafts-Marke Europas aufzubauen. Dafür suchen wir jemanden, der Social Media lebt, Shortform-Content versteht und Lust hat, eine Marke dieser Größe aktiv mitzugestalten. Deine Aufgaben Du schneidest Shortform-Videos für TikTok, Instagram Reels und YouTube Shorts und sorgst mit starken Hooks, Untertiteln, Pacing und Sounddesign dafür, dass sie bis zum Ende geschaut werden. Du lädst die Videos auf allen Plattformen hoch und kümmerst dich um Captions, Posting-Zeitpunkte und die Content-Planung. Du entwickelst neue Formate und Serien, testest sie und findest heraus, was beim Publikum funktioniert. Du behältst Trends im Blick und überträgst sie auf das Thema Neurowissenschaften. Du bist selbst täglich auf TikTok, Instagram und YouTube Shorts unterwegs und verstehst, warum ein Video durch die Decke ge

jobs.title: Produkt-Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Work @ everii Du denkst Produkte nicht in Features, sondern vom echten Bedarf der Nutzer aus? Du willst Strategie, Kundenfeedback und technische Möglichkeiten zusammenbringen – und unser Produkt vom ersten Tag an mitgestalten? Dann solltest du jetzt weiterlesen! Was dich erwartet Als Produkt-Manager denkst du vom Kunden aus – und von übermorgen her. Du kennst die Welt von Agenturen, Beratungen und IT-Dienstleistern: wie sie planen, abrechnen, kommunizieren, wachsen. Dieses Verständnis nutzt du, um nicht nur das nächste Feature zu durchdenken, sondern die Richtung des Produkts mitzubestimmen. Du arbeitest im engen Austausch mit Entwicklung und Customer Operations, bringst Kundenfeedback, die technische und strategische Perspektive zusammen – und hilfst dem Team, die richtigen Entscheidungen zur richtigen Zeit zu treffen. Aufgaben Deine Aufgaben Konzeption: Du fragst zuerst nach dem Warum. Die eigentliche Anforderung hinter einem Feature Request ist dein Ausgangspunk. Von dort denkst du Lösungsansätze ganzheitlich durch und bereitest sie präzise für die Entwicklung auf. Produkt-Design: Figma ist dir vertraut, und du hast ein Auge für Design – du erkennst, was ein Interface intuitiv, klar und angenehm nutzbar macht. Nah am User: Du bist regelmäßig im direkten Austausch mit Kunden, challengest Annahmen und weißt, was wirklich gebraucht und nicht nur laut gewünscht wird. Testing & QA: Du begleitest die Umsetzung aktiv, gibst Feedback im Prozess und stellst sicher, dass das fertige Feature die ursprüngliche Anforderung trifft. Blick auf das große Ganze: Du denkst unser Produkt nicht feature-weise, sondern in Richtungen. Du erkennst Muster in Kundenfeedback, Marktentwicklung und technischen Möglichkeiten – und hilfst dem Team, daraus klare Prioritäten zu machen. Blog & Handbuch: Du erklärst, was neu ist und warum es wichtig ist. Kurz, prägnant, und ohne Buzzwords Gutes Schreiben ist für dich kein Pflichtprogramm, sondern Teil der Arbeit. jobs.title: Senior Clinical Research Associate/ Clinical Research Associate II
jobs.description: Precision for Medicine is not your typical CRO. We are passionate about cultivating our culture and are proud to share extremely high CRA retention rates compared to industry averages. CRAs join us, love their jobs, and stay because of the amazing people and enjoyable quality of life. You will have a lower than average number of protocols, setting you up to be a protocol expert. Travel is reasonable and your work/life balance will benefit as a result. Most meaningfully - your voice will be heard. Working in a smaller CRO allows you to have influence and impact when it matters most and support from direct line management. We are hiring a Senior Clinical Research Associate/ Clinical Research Associate II, this position will be fully home based working in the UK or Northern Ireland.   About you: You are calm, thoughtful, and responsive when things don’t go as planned. You are well-prepared, whether it be for an investigator meeting, site visit or project team update, always staying two steps ahead of the game. You find quick and creative ways of overcoming difficulties. You have an impeccable eye for detail. You identify potential study risks and propose solutions on how to mitigate them. You take responsibility in the quality and outcomes of your work. You are adept at handling conflict by using tried and true resolution strategies. How we will keep you busy and support your growth: You will monitor and own the progress of clinical studies at investigative sites and ensure that clinical studies are conducted, recorded, and reported per protocol, SOPs, ICH-GCP, and all applicable regulations and standards. You will coordinate all necessary activities required to set up and monitor a study (i.e., identify investigators; helping prepare regulatory submissions, conducting pre-study and initiation visits, etc.). Qualifications: Minimum Required: 4-year college degree or equivalent experience Other Required: Candidates should ideally have more than 1 years

jobs.description: ABOUT QUINCE Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast. What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver. OUR CULTURE Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before. We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company s DNA.  Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place. Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power. To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose. Could that be you? Your mission UiPath’s Intelligence Document Processing drives understanding of the documents and messages on which a business runs: invoices, claims, contracts, customer emails. You'll be building the product that does it: the ingestion and extraction pipelines, the APIs customers build their operations on top of, and the systems that make those models useful, fast and trustworthy at enterprise scale. Increasingly that work is agentic. What you build is what lets AI agents ingest, understand, retrieve and reason over enterprise documents at volume, without giving up accuracy, security or governance. It's a product engineering role with complex systems and LLM-in-production problems underneath it. The same service handles a customer's first ten documents and another's ten million, runs in our cloud and inside a bank's own air-gapped datacentre, and has to be good enough that a business will act on its output. You'll write in several languages here, and pick up new ones as the problem demands. We care much more about how you think than about what you've written it in. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. The team sits at the intersection of research and production: you will take ideas from recent literature, form hypotheses, run experiments, and ship the techniques that prove out into our serving stack. This role sits between our inference engineers, who own the production serving stack, and our research scientists, who focus on paper-level contributions. You will be more science-focused than a pure engineer: you are expected to generate new ideas, keep up with the state of the art, and implement proof-of-concepts that bridge the gap between academic results and production impact. Some techniques you explore will be lossy or require integration into training — retraining models, tuning architectures, or training auxiliary models to improve inference. You will work closely with the Inference Foundation and Kernels teams, who turn your validated techniques into production recipes, and with pretraining and RL teams when your work touches model training. jobs.description: À propos de l’entreprise : L’ Agence Maritime La Pallice (AMLP) est un acteur majeur de la manutention portuaire et des services maritimes au sein du port de commerce de La Rochelle – La Pallice, l’un des ports en eau profonde les plus importants de France. AMLP fait partie du Groupe Maritime Kuhn, un groupe familial fondé en 1948, présent sur tout le littoral français avec 22 agences et 800 collaborateurs. Mission : Sous la responsabilité de la Responsable financière de pôle, vous assurez la tenue de la comptabilité en garantissant la régularité et la fiabilité des comptes. Vous contribuez au respect des procédures internes et à la production de documents comptables et financiers fiables. Vos principales responsabilités : Tenue de la comptabilité générale et analytique. Contrôle de la cohérence des documents comptables produits. Gestion des paiements et encaissements, ainsi que des oppositions. Suivi comptable des biens et raccordement avec l’inventaire (immobilisations). Production des déclarations fiscales mensuelles (TVA, DEB, etc.). Suivi de l’encaissement des créances clients et relances si nécessaire. Participation à la production des documents comptables et légaux (bilans, comptes de résultat, annexes, rapports de gestion). Participation aux relations avec les partenaires financiers (banques) et les organismes de contrôle (CAC, etc.). Veille à l’application des procédures comptables, financières, juridiques et qualité. Profil recherché : Compétences techniques : Maîtrise de la comptabilité générale et analytique et de la fiscalité. Bonne maîtrise des outils informatiques (Excel, Word, SAGE…). Compétences comportementales : Rigueur, autonomie, organisation et capacité à prioriser. Respect des délais. Esprit d’équipe. jobs.description: Vos missions Vos missions Rattaché(e) à la Direction Technique, vous pilotez l'ensemble de la fonction Produit. Vous définissez la stratégie produit, arbitrez les investissements, managez l'équipe et garantissez l'alignement des moyens engagés avec les objectifs de l'entreprise. En binôme avec le Product Lead, vous portez la vision, fixez le cadre stratégique et représentez le produit auprès de la Direction Générale. Principales responsabilités * Définir la stratégie d'un portefeuille multi-produits : investissements, priorités, évolution et cycle de vie des produits. * Appuyer chaque décision sur des données mesurables (revenus, usage, renouvellements, churn, coûts, risques). * Manager l'équipe Produit (Product Lead, Product Owners, Business Analysts, Product Designers, QA Engineers) : recrutement, accompagnement, évaluation et développement des compétences. * Fédérer les équipes autour d'objectifs clairs, stables et mesurables et faire vivre une culture produit orientée qualité et performance. * Construire et piloter le budget de la fonction Produit ainsi que l'organisation des équipes et des squads. * Garantir le respect des budgets et plannings, anticiper les risques et contribuer à la résolution des écarts. * Piloter la veille concurrentielle afin d'alimenter les orientations stratégiques et les roadmaps. * Développer l'innovation et l'usage de l'IA dans les pratiques produit (discovery, spécification, design, tests, documentation), dans un cadre sécurisé et conforme. * Représenter le produit auprès des dirigeants et arbitrer les décisions majeures inter-équipes. Environnement : Jira, Figma, Confluence, outils de data produit et solutions d'IA. jobs.title: Growth - France (CDD)
jobs.description: About Us At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, inverters and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets. We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand. We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel. Read more about what we’re building here . France is one of the most important flexibility markets in Europe. This role is critical to accelerating Axle’s growth in France. We’re looking for a commercially sharp, highly autonomous operator to drive Axle’s commercial success in the French market. This is a role that spans both sales and go to market. You’ll be responsible for both winning new partners (OEMs, utilities, platforms, etc.) and making those partnerships succeed over time. This is a multifaceted, client-facing role with a strong technical component. You will own the full commercial lifecycle and should be comfortable moving between strategic conversations, commercial negotiations, onboarding and account growth. You will speak native-level French and fluent English. Other European languages will also be an asset. This role will own: Winning new business Go-to-market strategy and execution Client onboarding and implementation support Account management and expansion What you will be doing Owning Axle’s commercial results for the French market (pipeline, revenue and partner success) Building and managing a strong pipeline of partners across key segments (OEMs, energy retailers, installers, platforms, etc.) Owning new customer acquisition end-to-end, from first conversation through to commercial close, setting our partners up to generate meaningful revenue Driving go-to-market
